title: Through a pointer
description:
Write in `solution.c`:

```c
void set_to(int *target, int value);       /* stores value where target points */
void add_to(int *total, int amount);       /* adds amount to the int total points at */
int *larger(int *a, int *b);               /* the pointer to the bigger value; a if they are equal */
int value_or(const int *p, int fallback);  /* *p, or fallback when p is NULL */
```

Add `#include <stddef.h>` for `NULL`.
hints: `*target = value;` writes through the pointer; `*total += amount;` adds to what it points at.
`larger` compares the values `*a` and `*b` but returns a pointer. `value_or` checks for `NULL` before following `p`.
